question_patterns: why do we have a belly button
what is the hole on my tummy
what was my belly button for
en.first_sentence: Your belly button is a mark from before you were born.
facts: Before birth, a tube joined a baby to its mother.
After birth, the tube falls off and leaves a belly button.
Other furry animals have one too, but it is a thin line.
en.ask_back: Is your belly button on your tummy, or your back?
